title: Flying Officer R McG Waterston
memorial_details: description: IN MEMORY OF/ FLYING OFFICER/ ROBIN McGREGOR/ "BUBBLE" WATERSTON/ OF NO. 630 SQUADRON AUX A.F./ WHO LOST HIS LIFE/ NEAR THIS SPOT/ ON 31st AUGUST 1940/ IN SPITFIRE X4273/ HE WAS 23 YEARS OLD/ ONE OF CHURCHILL'S FEW/ MEMORIAL DEDICATED ON/ 29th SEPT. 2009/ BY THE/ SHOREHAM AIRCRAFT MUSEUM/ KENT.
